instructions: Mentorship FAQ only. Use for short Q&A; use the paired Word document for detailed how-tos and edge cases. Follow the common rule book for shared assistant behaviour across all modules.

faqs.question: What is Mentorship on TEFConnect?
faqs.answer: Mentorship is where assigned mentors and mentees engage: view the assigned mentor or mentees, exchange messages, request changes, and complete surveys. It is not a self-serve browse-and-pick matching directory.

faqs.question: Can I browse and choose my own mentor?
faqs.answer: No. Mentees see the mentor already assigned. There is no logged-in browse directory to pick mentors. Public Find the right mentor copy opens registration/login, not a mentor catalogue.

faqs.question: Is Mentorship the same as Alumni Community?
faqs.answer: No. Alumni Community is the alumni hub. Mentorship is assigned mentor–mentee engagement. Alumni can become a TEF Coach and open Mentorship.

faqs.question: Who can open Mentorship as a mentee?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneurs need at least one programme with application_approved for Mentorship to appear. If LMS status is FAILED, Mentorship is disabled or redirects away from My Mentorship.

faqs.question: Why is Mentorship disabled or missing?
faqs.answer: It may be hidden if no programme is application_approved. If LMS is FAILED, the menu is disabled and My Mentorship redirects to Dashboard.

faqs.question: Who can access Mentorship as a mentor?
faqs.answer: Mentors sign in with a mentor account, complete Mentorship profile, and await admin approval when required. Then they use Dashboard, Mentee Requests, and My Mentee List.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Mentorship mentor and Alumni Community mentor?
faqs.answer: Mentorship mentor accounts use Mentorship menus. Alumni Community may show a Mentor/community mentor role for the alumni hub — that is not the same as Mentorship portal mentee-management menus.

faqs.question: What can I do on My Mentorship?
faqs.answer: View My Mentor, use My Messages / Engage With Your Mentor, submit Mentor Change Request, and Start Survey when available.

faqs.question: What if I have no mentor assigned?
faqs.answer: My Mentorship shows No mentor assigned. Messaging and mentor-linked actions depend on assignment. Mentees cannot self-assign a mentor.

faqs.question: Why do I only see one mentor?
faqs.answer: The mentee hub shows the primary assigned mentor. There is no multi-mentor switcher in this area.

faqs.question: How do mentee messages work?
faqs.answer: Use Engage With Your Mentor to Submit Message. Filter Responded/Not Responded. Edit/delete own unanswered mentee-initiated messages. Replies to mentor-initiated messages cannot be modified/deleted after sending. Attachments: up to 5; video ≤50 MB; other ≤10 MB.

faqs.question: What file types can I attach in Mentorship messages?
faqs.answer: PDF, DOC, DOCX, PNG, JPG, JPEG, MP4, XLSX, XLS, PPT, PPTX, TXT, within the size limits.

faqs.question: How do I request a mentor change?
faqs.answer: Open Mentor Change Request and choose a reason: Mentor indicated unavailability to continue; I am not satisfied with the mentorship support; Mentor is unresponsive; Delayed responses; Lack of domain expertise; or Others (Please specify).

faqs.question: How do mentorship surveys work for mentees?
faqs.answer: When notified, use Start Survey or Not Now. Statuses include Upcoming, Active, Expired. After submission, responses are not editable.

faqs.question: Can I edit survey answers after submitting?
faqs.answer: No. Submitted mentorship survey responses are not editable.

faqs.question: What do mentors complete on Mentorship profile?
faqs.answer: Name, email, gender, country, region, sector, preferred language, date of birth (18+), phone (8–15 digits), bio (max 200 words), government ID/passport (PNG/JPG/JPEG ≤5 MB), and CV (PDF/DOC/DOCX ≤5 MB). After submit, admin review may be required.

faqs.question: Why am I stuck on Mentorship profile as a mentor?
faqs.answer: Your profile may be incomplete, or your mentor account may not be approved yet. Dashboard use is blocked until approved.

faqs.question: What is Mentee Requests?
faqs.answer: Manage Mentee Requests lets mentors filter by programme, language, sector, and gender, search, and view Pending/Approved/Rejected. Open View then Approve, or Reject with Reject Reason and Submit.

faqs.question: What is My Mentee List?
faqs.answer: Manage Mentee List shows assigned mentees. Mentors can Request More Mentees, Change Mentee, Start Survey, and View details for Engage With Your Mentee messaging.

faqs.question: How do mentor messages work?
faqs.answer: From mentee details, mentors can message, update/delete eligible messages, and answer questions with the same attachment limits as mentees.

faqs.question: How do mentorship surveys work for mentors?
faqs.answer: From My Mentee List, Start Survey for a mentee. Complete Active surveys. Upcoming/Expired are shown by status. Submitted responses are not editable.

faqs.question: How do I become a TEF Coach from Alumni Community?
faqs.answer: Alumni profile → Become a TEF Coach or Re-apply (email required). Pending may show Complete Mentorship profile. After approval: Certified TEF Coach and Open Mentorship.

faqs.question: How do I return to Alumni Community from Mentorship?
faqs.answer: Use Back to Alumni Portal when available.

faqs.question: Are there live sessions, video calls, or certificates?
faqs.answer: Mentorship does not provide scheduling, calendar, or video call sessions. Certificates appears for mentors as Upcoming and is not a working feature yet.

faqs.question: What can members not do in Mentorship?
faqs.answer: Mentees cannot browse/self-select mentors or self-assign when none is assigned. No multi-mentor switcher. No live session tools. Certificates is Upcoming only. Mentorship is disabled when LMS FAILED.

faqs.question: I completed Training. Why is Mentorship still disabled?
faqs.answer: Mentorship stays disabled while LMS status is FAILED. If status is not failed and Mentorship is still missing, check that a programme is application_approved.

faqs.question: Why can’t I edit my reply?
faqs.answer: Once a reply is sent, Mentorship reply instructions say it cannot be modified or deleted.

faqs.question: How many results are on each mentee page?
faqs.answer: Mentee Requests and My Mentee List use pages of 10. Messages also paginate by 10.

faqs.question: What filters exist on mentee requests?
faqs.answer: Programme, Language, Sector, Gender with Apply/Reset, plus search and Pending/Approved/Rejected views.

faqs.question: Where do I find Survey Notification?
faqs.answer: On My Mentorship you may see Survey Notification with Not Now or Start Survey.

faqs.question: Does Find the right mentor on the public site open Mentorship matching?
faqs.answer: No. That public marketing action opens registration or login, not an in-Mentorship mentor directory.

faqs.question: Can I request more mentees?
faqs.answer: Yes. On My Mentee List use Request More Mentees.

faqs.question: Can I change a mentee?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Change Mentee from My Mentee List when offered, with the mentee change request reasons form.

faqs.question: What TEF Coach statuses exist?
faqs.answer: None, Pending, Approved, and Rejected. Pending can still open Mentorship SSO to complete profile; badge appears after Approved.

faqs.question: Do mentors use the entrepreneur Mentorship menu?
faqs.answer: No. Mentors use Mentorship mentor menus (requests, mentee list). Entrepreneurs use My Mentorship.

faqs.question: Is Mentorship chat realtime like Marketplace chat?
faqs.answer: Mentorship messaging is ask/reply message threads with attachments, not a separate Marketplace-style realtime chat product.

faqs.question: Can I schedule a Zoom session in Mentorship?
faqs.answer: No. Live sessions/calendar/video calls are not available in Mentorship.

faqs.question: What is the mentor bio limit?
faqs.answer: Maximum 200 words.

faqs.question: What is the minimum mentor age?
Who assigns my mentor?
faqs.answer: Assignment is handled through the programme / mentor-request process outside mentee self-serve browsing. Mentors Approve/Reject mapped requests.

faqs.question: What if Alumni session restore fails when returning from Mentorship?
faqs.answer: You may need to sign in to Alumni Community again if the Alumni session was not saved.

faqs.question: Survey status filter on mentee list does nothing.
faqs.answer: Survey status filtering on the mentee list may not change rows until survey data exists.

faqs.question: How do I search my Mentorship messages?
faqs.answer: Use the message search on My Mentorship / mentee details messaging, and filter Responded or Not Responded.

faqs.question: What does Know more mean on my mentor card?
faqs.answer: It expands or reveals more of the mentor bio beyond the short preview.

faqs.question: Are Certificates available for mentors?
faqs.answer: Certificates is listed as Upcoming and is not a working Mentorship feature yet.

faqs.question: Can partners use Mentorship mentee hub?
faqs.answer: Mentorship mentee hub is for entrepreneur Mentorship access rules described above. Partner Training roles are separate in LMS.

faqs.question: What appears on mentor Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Mentorship activity summaries such as assigned mentees, pending requests, and messages, for approved mentors.

faqs.question: What reasons can mentors use for mentee change / more mentees?
faqs.answer: Mentors submit Request More Mentees or Change Mentee using the Mentorship request forms with the reasons provided in that form.

faqs.question: I am alumni and Mentorship appears but login fails.
faqs.answer: My Mentorship primarily expects an entrepreneur Mentorship session. If access fails, sign in with the correct account type or use the TEF Coach / Mentorship path from Alumni when applicable.
